assessment: This manuscript employs in vitro studies and elegant mouse models to detail how specific pyruvate kinase isoforms impact pancreatic β-cell ATP/ADP levels, ATP-sensitive K+ channel (KATP channel) activity, calcium handling, and insulin secretion. This is an important study that challenges the current paradigms of KATP-channel regulation, the major signaling mechanism through which pancreatic β cells couple blood glucose levels to insulin release. Future studies will determine whether similar mechanisms are used in human pancreatic β cells.
